title: Operator-controlled synthetic fixture review inventory
description: A bounded local operator review record, not mathematical proof that data is synthetic and not caller consent or permission to send a model request. No HTTP inventory write endpoint. Runtime requires a controlled regular file of at most 32768 bytes, strict JSON, matching deployment, unique inventory IDs and a valid future expiry no more than 24 hours after reviewedAt. Missing, malformed, changed or expired proof fails closed; every change invalidates previously bound batch proof. No URL or arbitrary path is supplied in the file.

entries.description: Duplicate inventoryId values are rejected at runtime even when the remaining entry fields differ. Every entry must pass validation, not only the selected one.

Uuid.description: Canonical lowercase UUID; shortened or uppercase representations are rejected.

ShortReference.description: Non-sensitive ASCII review/version reference only, never an account identifier, URL, path or credential. Secret-like sk-, ghp_ and github_pat_ prefixes are rejected case-insensitively.

reviewedAt.description: Must not be in the future. Runtime validates every entry against the current UTC clock.

expiresAt.description: After reviewedAt and current UTC time, at most 24 hours after reviewedAt. Batch expiry cannot exceed this expiry.
